description:
FILED s473b (Opus, 2026-09-07) from the #1010 probe battery
(scratch/s473b/probe/m1010b.pl row 14).  PRE-EXISTING: the same answer on
782bc37e, before #1010's change, and in the COPYING consumer as well, so it is
not about aliasing.

    use strict; use warnings;
    ... (a file big enough that VarAnnotator gives $r the raw-slot verdict) ...
    { my $r; my @z; my @v = @$r{"a"};  print ref($r) || "U", "\n"; }
        perl  HASH        PCL  U

THE CAUSE, and the reason this is worth filing rather than shrugging at: it is
DECIDED BY AN OPTIMIZATION, and the two settings DISAGREE.

    PCL_OPT=none      prints HASH   (right)
    default           prints U      (wrong)

`@$r{'a'}` lowers to `(p-hslice (p-cast-% $r) "a")`.  `p-cast-%` on an undef
BOX vivifies by writing the new hash back into the box; on a RAW slot there is
no box to write into, so the fresh hash goes to the temporary and the root
stays undef.  Which of the two `$r` gets is the s455 raw-slot verdict â in a
small file it is boxed and the program is right, in a bigger one it is raw and
the same program is wrong.  That is exactly the invariant `Pl/t/passes-01.t`
exists for: PCL_OPT=none must RUN identically.

THE FIX SHAPE is #1241's, one level out.  `%p-viv-root` (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp)
already solves this for a CHAIN root: "a raw lexical slot is still a CL place,
and SETF reaches it".  The slice's container is the same question with a
different marker: the emitter would mark the container of a DEREF slice the way
it marks a dereferenced chain container (`p-viv-container`), and the marker's
expansion would take the %p-viv-root arm for a symbol place.  Check the
ELEMENT sibling at the same time â `my $r; my $v = $$r{'a'}` is task #1350,
which is the same root question for a single-level deref, and the two should
land together.

RELATED (found in the same probe run, do NOT confuse them):
  #1349  ref() of a box holding host NIL answers "ARRAY"
  #1350  a SINGLE-level deref read does not vivify its ref
  #1351  a compound assign over a DEREF element evaluates its KEY twice

SIZE: unknown; no baseline row is known to sit behind it (found by probe).  A
filler, but the PCL_OPT disagreement makes it more than cosmetic.
subject: SILENT WRONG (pre-existing): a deref-rooted SLICE whose root has the RAW-SLOT verdict does not vivify the root â `my $r; my @v = @$r{'a'}` leaves $r undef where perl makes it a hashref, and `PCL_OPT=none` gets it RIGHT
